summary_feedback: Your paragraph contains multiple basic grammar, spelling, and tense errors that make the writing informal and unclear. Pay attention to correct verb forms, standard spelling, and capitalization of "I." Try to break long run-on sentences into shorter, correctly punctuated ones for better structure.

issues.quote: i dont wanted to walk anymore
issues.comment: Incorrect negation and verb tense; use past simple with 'did not'.
issues.correction: I did not want to walk anymore

issues.quote: yesturday i was going to the shop but then the rain was like super heavy so i dont wanted to walk anymore but my friend sayed its fine and we go anyways.
issues.comment: Run-on sentence with multiple clauses joined only by 'but' and 'so'.
issues.correction: Yesterday I went to the shop, but then the rain was very heavy, so I did not want to walk anymore. However, my friend said it's fine, and we went anyway.
